name: Fire Mountains: Volcanoes That Changed History
description: From the lava floods that nearly ended life to Vesuvius, Krakatoa and Tambora: the eruptions that cooled the climate, buried towns and shaped our world.

checkpoints.name: Floods of lava
checkpoints.note: The biggest eruptions in Earth's history pour out lava over Siberia and India, poisoning the air and helping to drive mass extinctions.

checkpoints.name: The giants of the Ice Age
checkpoints.note: Volcanoes such as Etna, Fuji and Yellowstone build up and blow, and the huge Toba eruption shakes the whole planet.

checkpoints.name: Collapse and rebirth
checkpoints.note: Mount Mazama collapses to form Crater Lake and Thera explodes, burying Akrotiri and shaking the Aegean, while Vesuvius and Etna remain close neighbours of human settlements.

checkpoints.name: Eruptions that changed history
checkpoints.note: Samalas, Tambora and Krakatoa darken skies and cool the climate, causing crop failures, tsunamis and tens of thousands of deaths, and Pelée destroys Saint-Pierre.

checkpoints.name: Eruptions we watch
checkpoints.note: Satellites and seismometers let scientists watch Surtsey, St. Helens, Pinatubo and Eyjafjallajökull, saving lives and showing how new land and ash clouds behave.
